 th  Dated this the 7 day of April, 2025  COMMON JUDGMENT All these appeals are preferred by the respective claimants against the award passed by the Motor Accidents Claims tribunal, Pala in OP (MV) Nos. 944, 946, 973, 974 & 949 of 2017.

2. The brief facts necessary for the disposal of the appeals are as follows:-
On 06.03.2017 when the appellants, except in MACA No.2070 of 2021, were travelling in a van bearing registration No. KL-17/H-1071 driven by one Jose Jacob through Kanjiramala - Vaikom kavala public road and when the van reached the Vaikom kavala, due to the rash and negligent driving of the driver, the vehicle hit a mud bund on the opposite side of the road.

The minor son of the claimants in MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 O.P.(M.V.) No.944 of 2017/appellants in M.A.C.A No. 2070 of 2021 died in the aforesaid accident.
All other claimants sustained serious injuries in the accident.

The legal heirs of deceased as well as other claimants, who sustained different percentages of disability due to the injury sustained by them in the accident approached the tribunal claiming compensation under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988.

The tribunal proceeded to consider the evidence on record,
produced as Ext. A1 to A28 and granted compensation depending upon the percentage of disability by applying the principles laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Master Mallikarjun Vs. National insurance Company and others., [(2013)
ACJ 2445].

It is against these findings, the respective claimants have preferred the above appeals.
4.
Heard Sri. Cyriac Kurian, the learned counsel for the appellants and Sri. Lal K. Joseph, the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the insurance company.
5. On consideration of the rival submissions raised across the bar, this Court is of the considered view that all the appellants are entitled for enhanced compensation.
As stated above these appeals pertain to claim for compensation either on account of death of a minor or on account of the disability suffered by the respective minors in the road traffic accident.
In the case where the death of the minor is involved, the tribunal applied the principles laid down by this Court in Assainar (supra).

However in the light of the decision of this Court in The Branch Manager, United India Insurance company Ltd. vs. Mujeeb Rahman A. P., [2025 (1) KHC 606], the claimants in OP (M V)
No. 944 of 2017 are entitled for a MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 better compensation, which will be discussed in detail in the preceding paragraphs.

entities.text: Branch Manager, United India Insurance company Ltd. vs. Mujeeb Rahman A. P., [2025 (1) KHC 606]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. As regards the claim on account of the injury sustained by the respective minors, the question before this court is whether the claimants are entitled for fixation of notional income and calculating the compensation on the basis of the multiplier system or applying consolidated compensation going by the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Master Mallikarjun (Supra).
The tribunal applied the principles laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Master Mallikarjun (Supra) and awarded a compensation.

However, though this Court cannot find fault with the finding of the tribunal applying the principles laid down in Master Mallikarjun (supra), in the light of the subsequent decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Kajal v. Jagdish Chand and Others [2020 (4)
SCC 413] and also in Master Jyothis Raj Krishna v. Sunny George & Anr. [2025 ACJ 53], even in a case of the injuries sustained by a minor in a road traffic accident, MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 the compensation for permanent disability has to be calculated by fixing the notional income and also by applying the multiplier system.

sentences.text: Therefore, it becomes inevitable to this Court to conclude that the award passed by the tribunal requires modification.
7. The next question is what should be the notional income of the deceased minor and other claimants who were minors at the time of accident.
At one hand the claimants contend that the income fixed by the tribunal is dismally low and the same is on par with that of a coolie worker.
On the other hand the Insurance company contends that in case of minors, only a consolidated notional income can be fixed.
8. All the persons who were involved in the accidents are students.

Insofar as income of the student is concerned, it would be wholly unjustified if they are considered on par with that of a coolie Ethna Joy (Minor) vs The New India Assurance Co. Ltd on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100867141/

sentences.text: The supreme Court in Angad Tiwari Vs National Insurance company (Civil Appeal 10950 of 2024 decided on 01-10-2024) held that while fixing notional income MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 in a claim under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988

sentences.text: , the same shall not be fixed below the minimum wage fixed by the State.

9. Considering the above decision and also the various other precedents on the point, this court in Mujeeb Rahman A.P.(supra) held that the principles laid down by this court in Assainar(supra) no longer holds the field in view of the subsequent pronouncement by the Supreme Court in Angad Tiwari(supra) and Master Ayush(supra).

After considering the nuances leading to the fixation of notional income of a minor involved in an accident, this court fixed the notional income of a minor at 18,000.
10.

In the light of the above decisions, this court is of the considered view that the the appellants herein are also entitled for the same benefit and accordingly the notional income is fixed at Rs.18,000/-.
The appellants in MACA No. 2070 of 2021 are entitled to reckon 40% future prospects.

Consequently, in cases where the claimants have suffered MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021,
2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 permanent disability
they will be entitled to compensation on that count, whereas the appellants in M.A.C.A. No.2070 of 2021 are entitled to compensation under the head loss of dependency.
11. As an upshot of the above discussion, the appellants are entitled to succeed.

Accordingly, these appeals are allowed and the appellants are granted enhancement in compensation as follows:
MACA No. 2070 of 2021 :-
By applying the principles laid down in Mujeeb Rahman (Supra)
, the notional income of the deceased, Anna Mariya is fixed at Rs.18,000/- plus 40% future prospects is Rs.25,200/-.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
In the case where the death of the minor is involved, the tribunal applied the principles laid down by this Court in Assainar (supra).
However in the light of the decision of this Court in The Branch Manager, United India Insurance company Ltd. vs. Mujeeb Rahman A. P., [2025 (1) KHC 606], the claimants in OP (M V)
No. 944 of 2017 are entitled for a MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 better compensation, which will be discussed in detail in the preceding paragraphs.
However, though this Court cannot find fault with the finding of the tribunal applying the principles laid down in Master Mallikarjun (supra), in the light of the subsequent decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Kajal v. Jagdish Chand and Others [2020 (4)
SCC 413] and also in Master Jyothis Raj Krishna v. Sunny George & Anr. [2025 ACJ 53], even in a case of the injuries sustained by a minor in a road traffic accident, MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 the compensation for permanent disability has to be calculated by fixing the notional income and also by applying the multiplier system.
Therefore, it becomes inevitable to this Court to conclude that the award passed by the tribunal requires modification.
The supreme Court in Angad Tiwari Vs National Insurance company (Civil Appeal 10950 of 2024 decided on 01-10-2024) held that while fixing notional income MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021, 2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 in a claim under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988
Consequently, in cases where the claimants have suffered MACA Nos.2070 of 2021, 1999 of 2021,
2083 of 2021, 2088 of 2021 & 2131 of 2021 2025:KER:30695 permanent disability
they will be entitled to compensation on that count, whereas the appellants in M.A.C.A. No.2070 of 2021 are entitled to compensation under the head loss of dependency.
opennyai_summary.issue:
6. As regards the claim on account of the injury sustained by the respective minors, the question before this court is whether the claimants are entitled for fixation of notional income and calculating the compensation on the basis of the multiplier system or applying consolidated compensation going by the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Master Mallikarjun (Supra).
7. The next question is what should be the notional income of the deceased minor and other claimants who were minors at the time of accident.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The appellants in MACA No. 2070 of 2021 are entitled to reckon 40% future prospects.
11. As an upshot of the above discussion, the appellants are entitled to succeed.
Accordingly, these appeals are allowed and the appellants are granted enhancement in compensation as follows:

, the notional income of the deceased, Anna Mariya is fixed at Rs.18,000/- plus 40% future prospects is Rs.25,200/-.

The insurance company shall deposit the same within a period of two months from the date of receipt of the copy of this judgment.
The appeals are ordered accordingly.
